workflow: A container-copy operation iterates internal entries while invoking user-defined callbacks to retrieve or store each item.
A callback re-enters and mutates the source container, removing or replacing entries and invalidating traversal storage.
The copy operation continues using a cached entry or key without retaining stable ownership or detecting the mutation first.
It dereferences the invalidated entry, causing a use-after-free crash instead of reporting that the container changed during copying.
summary: Reentrant container mutation invalidates copy traversal state
decision_reason: The failure workflow materially matches reentrant mutation invalidating storage held by an ongoing container operation, which then continues through the invalidated state.
